answer: The sonnet schedule is applied in fable and trellis publishes each instalment. An attacker therefore cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A payout is split and therefore 45% arrives at settlement and the rest over 19 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 4954 identities would post 4996 proofs and burn roughly 24 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
